item.title: 🟠 Ubiquiti Patches Critical UniFi Flaws Across Connect, Talk, Access, Protect, and OS
item.description:
Why this matters: Privilege escalation risk — review local admin exposure and endpoint controls.
Ubiquiti has shipped updates to address multiple critical security flaws impacting UniFi Connect, UniFi Talk, UniFi Access, UniFi Protect, and UniFi OS that could result in privilege escalation and arbitrary command execution. item.title: 🟠 Felons, Fraudsters Flog Offensive Cybersecurity Startup
item.description:
Why this matters: Leadership context — useful for risk, budget, and vendor conversations.
A cybersecurity startup dangling millions of dollars to acquire zero-day security vulnerabilities in popular software is run by a pair of far-right conspiracy theorists and convicted felons whose most recent ventures included fake intelligence companies and a now-defunct AI-based lobbying platform they operated under assumed names.

Source: Krebs on Security  |  Severity: Important  |  Age: 3h ago

item.title: 🟠 15-Year-Old GhostLock Flaw Enables Root and Container Escape on Most Linux Distros
item.description:
Why this matters: Leadership context — useful for risk, budget, and vendor conversations.
Researchers at Nebula Security have disclosed GhostLock (CVE-2026-43499), a 15-year-old Linux kernel flaw that lets any logged-in user take full root control of a machine that has not been patched.
